{{Top|leg}}
'''Rukaros''' were creatures native to [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. They had four sets of claws as long as a [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] hand, mouthfuls of teeth, and poison-barbed tails. [[Vestara Khai]] was forced to fight four rukaros to prove she was ready for her [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith]] [[Sith training|training]].
